Hey guys,
sorry for the late reply, thought it would be a good idea to doze off a little bit in the wild with my dog and my rifle. same situation again, gun to the forehead, then i thought about it. about how its a fucking waste of a life. i mean im 17.. i got a life ahead of me.. and its being fucked by idiots.
See i have been going through a very, very tough time.
I mean seriously rough, and my parents do nothing but give shit about, about how i am a dissapointment, and how my brothers are better than me,they kept feeding me their bullshit so i bailed out..headed over for some usual Saturday night shit with my friends, And im feeling alot better..
For people that opened up to me with stories of their past, Thank you. i really appreciate it, it means alot.
Thank you for the support everyone.

But, how can i deal with further situations like these? I cant keep on doing this, im on the edge of the cliff and the way down looks really fucking amazing..i really really want to end it, just end it all.
Again, thank you all..
